title: Define the catch-me-up reply, sharpen capture triage and harvest lenses, and fix verify-upkeep landing
action: Adopt the remaining L4 and L6 practices (per D2 and D4). Never rename a cited heading. Do NOT run bee dev regen (wave-barrier). routing-and-contracts.md § 'Communication contract': add a 'Catch-me-up reply' rule for a user who asks to be caught up: one scope line; a short capsule of where the work stands; one line per feature or worktree with exactly one status tag taken from bee state and written in the user's words (merged, open worktree, cell in flight, capped not merged, parked); what was tried and reverted, from feature reports and superseded decisions; one next action. bee-capturing/SKILL.md: in 'Capture the moment it settles', a decision's why names its evidence pointer (commit, path:line, output path), never prose; in Compound step 3, check that each capped cell's proof pointer resolves before the harvest (a dead pointer is a friction entry), and dispatch the harvest readers through the dispatch door as gathers with two named lenses — learnings, and divergent (self-reported proof, second-order effects, context the user pasted that the agent could have fetched); in Compound step 4, when the target already states the lesson and the run still broke it, promote a wording or placement change that makes it fire, never a second copy, and a single source clears the bar only with a named waste figure while two independent sources raise confidence. bee-verify-upkeep/SKILL.md: add step 0 — with no .bee/verify/verify-app/SKILL.md, stop and route to bee-verifying; change the 'changed' landing step from one PR to one worktree and one cell proven by the re-driven features' green:live lines, landed with bee worktree merge. Skill edits by capture still go through bee-evolving or bee-writing-skills. Cite qualified pointers without the skills/ prefix.
verify: rg -q 'Catch-me-up reply' skills/bee-hive/references/routing-and-contracts.md && rg -q 'divergent' skills/bee-capturing/SKILL.md && ! rg -q 'one PR' skills/bee-verify-upkeep/SKILL.md
